entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a single heavy gate door leaf of vertical dark timber planks held by three black iron straps with big rivets and a round woad blue painted shield nailed at the centre, one single loose flat panel, nearly twice as tall as it is wide, seen face-on.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting. Planks: weathered dark brown timber (#5E4632). Straps and rivets: black iron (#2E2E30). The shield nailed at the centre: bright saturated woad blue (#2F4E9C) paint over its whole face with a thin iron rim. No text.
